title: A data item is a first-class graph thing
description:
As a graph consumer, I want a data item to appear as its own thing in dataflow.json, so that personal data is not only a string hanging on an edge.

Feature: data item in the graph

  Scenario: Unique personal-data thing is a node
    Given a scan that finds a customer email field
    When I read dataflow.json
    Then there is a data item for that email
    And it is not only listed under an edge dataCategories string

  Scenario: Two mentions can be one data item
    Given user.ts and customer.ts both declare email
    And they are the same declared data item
    When I read dataflow.json
    Then there is one data item
    And both mentions are evidence on it
